briefdescription.para: Compliance framework integration for ThemisDB governance module.

detaileddescription.para:
1.0.0
2026-08-18
Provides unified compliance requirement mapping and validation for multiple regulatory frameworks:
EU AI Act
SOC 2 Type I/II
ISO 27001:2022
GDPR
CCPA/CPRA
HIPAA
PCI-DSS

Supports:
Framework → Requirement → Control mapping with versioning
Regulatory section to technical control linkage
Multi-framework simultaneous validation
Compliance violation reporting with severity
Evidence collection and remediation tracking

simplesect.para:
Performance targets:
Validation check latency ≤1s
Report generation ≤5s
Framework query ≤100ms
